code.label: Shared runner: validation, quarantine, audit, errors

highlights.label: Feed configuration: provider A (CSV, custom adapter)
notes: Everything provider-specific is here: file format, options, column mapping, and the adapter name.
The rules block is shared with every other feed, so validation is identical.

highlights.label: Feed configuration: provider B (JSON, configuration only)
notes: adapter: generic means no provider code. Nested JSON fields are mapped with dot paths.
Diff this file against provider A to see everything that differs between the two sources.

highlights.label: Provider-specific code stays in its adapter
notes: Only the status-code lookup is provider-specific; reading and mapping reuse the generic adapter.
Adding a provider with a new quirk means one new adapter function, registered in adapters/__init__.py.

highlights.label: One shared runner for every feed
notes: The same function runs for every feed: adapter, validation, quarantine, MERGE, audit.
The finally block writes the audit row whether the feed succeeds or fails.
Errors are re-raised so the job's retry and alert settings apply.

highlights.label: Rules compile from configuration to SQL
notes: Rules come from the use-case spec, not code.
Each row gets an array of failed rule names, so quarantine records say why a row was rejected.

highlights.label: Audit: transformation runs and pipeline updates (system.lakeflow)
notes: Jobs and pipelines are found by their capability_guide_job tag, so the queries work in any workspace.
Each row is one job run or pipeline update with trigger, identity, and result.

highlights.label: Audit: who changed or started them, lineage, and query activity
notes: system.access.audit records who created, edited, ran, or repaired the job and pipeline.
table_lineage shows which job or pipeline wrote each table; query.history shows SQL warehouse reads and writes.
Spark reads and writes from serverless jobs appear in lineage rather than query history.

highlights.label: Alert: quarantine rate above the threshold
notes: A SQL alert evaluates the audit table hourly and emails when any feed quarantines more than quarantine_alert_pct.
The threshold is a bundle variable, so each environment can set its own.

highlights.label: Job parameters flow into task parameters and for_each inputs
notes: Job parameters default to bundle variables, so one deployment can run another use case with --params use_case=<spec>.
{{job.parameters.use_case}} selects the spec and feed folder for every task.
for_each iterates the feed list the first task publishes as a task value.

highlights.label: Feed configs are rendered from the use-case spec
notes: Feed configs are generated from the spec, and the output order is fixed, so diffs stay small.
Shared rules are appended to every feed; feed-specific rules can be added per feed.

highlights.label: Sample data is generated deterministically from the spec
notes: dbldatagen builds the canonical entity from the spec's column definitions.
A fixed seed means every run lands identical rows, so reruns are idempotent.

highlights.label: Auto Loader streaming table
notes: STREAM read_files is Auto Loader: each update reads only files it has not seen.
_metadata.file_path and ingested_at give lineage and latency inputs per row.

highlights.label: Expectations and per-row latency
notes: Expectations drop invalid rows and record pass and fail counts in the pipeline event log.
latency_seconds measures event time to ingestion time for each row.

highlights.label: Latency and throughput metrics
notes: Metrics are appended per job run, so latency and throughput can be compared across runs.
The pipeline update ID and state link each metrics row to the pipeline update.

highlights.label: Retry, alert, and health rule settings
notes: Failure and duration alerts route to the notification address; the health rule flags slow runs.
max_retries and min_retry_interval_millis retry the ingest task on transient failures.
max_concurrent_runs: 1 prevents overlapping runs from writing the same tables.

highlights.label: Simulated transient failure exercised by the retry policy
notes: The first attempt writes a marker and fails; the retry finds the marker and continues.
This stands in for a source that is briefly unavailable.

highlights.label: Rollback to an earlier Delta version
notes: With no version given, the restore target is the version before the latest write.
RESTORE is itself recorded in Delta history, so the rollback is auditable.

walkthroughs.label: Environment separation: workspaces, Unity Catalog, metastores

highlights.label: Job runs joined to job tags from system tables
notes: All runs in the workspace are included; tag columns let the dashboard filter to guide jobs.
Joining on ops_context scopes account-wide system tables to this workspace.

highlights.label: Usage and list-price cost by SKU
notes: List prices are joined by SKU and the price's effective window.
Usage is grouped by day, SKU, and product for cost trends.

highlights.label: Alert routing from job and alert settings
notes: Notification destinations are not in system tables, so they come from the Jobs and Alerts APIs.
The result is one table that shows which alert routes where.

highlights.label: Transform with the edge case the tests catch
notes: Keys are normalized before de-duplication, which is the edge case the unit test catches.
Window ordering with nulls last keeps the latest dated version of each key.

highlights.label: Same tests run locally and on serverless
notes: The same pytest suite runs locally and in the serverless job task.
A non-zero exit fails the task, so broken code cannot reach the transform step.

highlights.label: Post-transform SQL checks
notes: assert_true fails the SQL task when a check does not hold.
The checks run on the warehouse after the Python transform writes the table.

highlights.label: Approval-gated promotion of the same commit
notes: deploy-test waits for deploy-dev and for approval on the test GitHub environment.
The same commit SHA is deployed and tagged as release on every resource.

highlights.label: dev and test targets with release tags
notes: dev uses development mode; test uses presets for name prefixes and tags.
Environment-specific values come from variables, not edits to resource files.

highlights.label: Profile quality per column
notes: Row count, null rate per column, and key uniqueness are computed in one query.
These numbers feed both the docs page and the AI prompt.

highlights.label: Draft descriptions with ai_query
notes: ai_query drafts table and column descriptions from schema, profile, and lineage.
The model returns JSON that the job applies as Unity Catalog comments.

highlights.label: Render one documentation page
notes: One markdown page per table covers ownership, schema, quality, lineage, and usage.
Pages are regenerated on every refresh, so they track the table.

highlights.label: Classify legacy constructs
notes: Each legacy step is classified by its main construct (MERGE, cursor, temp table, and so on).
The classification drives whether a step can be converted automatically.

highlights.label: Transpile T-SQL to Databricks SQL
notes: sqlglot transpiles T-SQL to Databricks SQL; failures are recorded as manual remediation instead of raising.
Temp tables and schema names are rewritten to the target catalog and schema.

highlights.label: Role-based effort model
notes: Effort is estimated per role from counts of clean, warning, and manual steps.
Assumptions are stored with each row so the estimate can be reviewed.

highlights.label: Classify changes and enforce the semver bump
notes: Every change between two contract versions is classified as breaking or nonbreaking.
The version bump must match: minor for nonbreaking, major for breaking.

highlights.label: Publish v2 and keep v1 consumers working
notes: The old table is renamed and the old name becomes a compatibility view over v2.
v1 is tagged deprecated with a sunset date and a comment pointing to v2.

highlights.label: Release gate with a mislabeled-release dry run
notes: The gate checks every consecutive pair of contract versions.
A dry run relabels the breaking release as a minor version and shows the gate rejecting it.

recordedRuns.label: Model release run (train, test, approve, deploy)

docs.label: Manage model lifecycle in Unity Catalog

highlights.label: Quality gate and champion comparison
notes: Thresholds come from bundle variables, so dev and test enforce different bars.
A challenger must beat the current champion by the configured margin before promotion.

highlights.label: Approval gate
notes: Promotion needs an approver: the approved_by job parameter (CI passes the GitHub reviewer) or an approvals table row.
Without one, the run succeeds but stops before promotion, so nothing unapproved is deployed.

highlights.label: Deploy the champion and wait for READY
notes: The job polls until the endpoint is ready and the config update finishes.
A scoring request then measures latency for the release record.

walkthroughs.label: Environment separation: workspaces, Unity Catalog, metastores

highlights.label: Read one named Excel sheet
notes: dataAddress selects the sheet; the cell form Orders!A1 fails.
Schema hints keep dates and numbers typed; Excel needs schemaEvolutionMode none.

highlights.label: Build files locally, then copy to the volume
notes: An .xlsx is a zip and can't be written straight to a volume path.
Every format is generated from the use-case spec.

highlights.label: 24 format checks
notes: Counts, rescued data, and types per format.
The job fails on any mismatch.

highlights.label: Paginate with retries and token refresh
notes: A 401 refreshes the token and retries once; 429 and 5xx back off and honor Retry-After.
Every HTTP attempt becomes one request-log row.

highlights.label: Refresh tokens before they expire
notes: Tokens refresh at a set age, not only after a failure.
The reference run refreshed three times over seven pages.

highlights.label: Land records and the request log
notes: Writes api_users, api_request_log, and api_pull_runs.
Fails if record count, distinct ids, and the API total disagree.

highlights.label: Fetch only new files
notes: Credentials come from a secret scope, never the code.
Files already in sftp_transfer_log are skipped.

highlights.label: Decide what is new
notes: A file is new by path, size, and modified time.
The same logic runs against a volume when SFTP is blocked.

highlights.label: Prove the second fetch copies nothing
notes: refetch_finds_nothing reruns the fetch after ingestion.
It fails if anything is copied twice.

highlights.label: Three sources, one conformed table
notes: Each source maps to the same seven columns and sets source_system.
Expectations fail the update if source_system or source_id is null.

highlights.label: Prepare database, file, and API inputs
notes: Builds a Delta extract, a landed CSV, and API pages.
Reuses the REST client from the API guide.

highlights.label: Check counts per source
notes: 120 database, 80 file, and 60 API rows in the reference run.
(source_system, source_id) must be unique.

highlights.label: Custom query with joins, window, and a function
notes: The query runs inside the source database.
net_amount() is a database function called from the query.

highlights.label: One checksum on both sides
notes: The same canonical-row md5 runs in Postgres and Spark SQL.
Counts, checksums, and types must match.

highlights.label: Extract through the connection
notes: remote_query runs full tables and custom SQL in Postgres.
A foreign catalog was not allowed here, so remote_query is used.

highlights.label: Cast with a reject path
notes: try_cast splits good rows from bad ones.
Rejected rows carry a reason string.

highlights.label: Iterate over each group's records
notes: Orders are collected into an array per customer.
transform, aggregate, and filter run on the array.

highlights.label: Independent expected counts
notes: Each view is paired with its own expected-count query.
11,476 valid plus 524 rejected equals 12,000 orders.

highlights.label: SCD type 1 and type 2 from one feed
notes: Two AUTO CDC INTO flows with APPLY AS DELETE WHEN.
Only STORED AS differs between them.

highlights.label: Plan inserts, updates, and deletes
notes: Disjoint ids by stride keep the change batch deterministic.
60 inserts, 150 updates, 40 deletes in the reference run.

highlights.label: Count current, history, and deleted keys
notes: SCD type 2 kept 1,210 history rows; type 1 kept 1,020.
Fails if counts differ from the spec.

highlights.label: One MERGE for insert, update, and delete
notes: whenMatchedDelete, whenMatchedUpdate, and whenNotMatchedInsert in one statement.
Operation metrics come from Delta history.

highlights.label: Formatted Excel output
notes: Bold header, fitted widths, frozen header, number format.
Built in a temp folder and copied to the volume.

highlights.label: Column widths and merge metrics
notes: Pure helpers covered by unit tests.
Widths come from the longest value per column.

highlights.label: The whole task graph
notes: Condition task branches, a run_if join, retries, notifications, and a health rule.
record_run still runs when one branch is excluded.

highlights.label: Call an external process
notes: A shell command and an HTTP request from one task.
Attempt 0 fails on purpose so the retry shows.

highlights.label: Pause every scheduled guide job
notes: Jobs are found by tag; only unpaused ones are flipped.
Resume restores only the jobs this run paused.

highlights.label: Wait for lineage, then walk it
notes: Lineage appeared about 13 minutes after the writes, so the task polls.
Table and column lineage for source, silver, and gold.

highlights.label: Detect schema drift
notes: information_schema snapshots around each ALTER.
Each change is matched to its Delta history version.

highlights.label: Detect data drift
notes: A data profiling monitor refreshes before and after the shifted batch.
PSI and mean shift are also computed in the job.

highlights.label: Time a 6M-row aggregation
notes: 6 million rows generated with dbldatagen, then aggregated.
Each step's time goes to large_aggregation_timing.

highlights.label: Python and pandas round trip
notes: toPandas, pivot and rolling means, then back to a table.
The re-read row count is asserted.

highlights.label: R with sparklyr
notes: Aggregates in Spark, then fits lm and quantile in R.
Shipped but not run: serverless has no R runtime.

highlights.label: Upload to a per-user path, then join
notes: The CSV lands under uploads/<user>/.
A full outer join labels matched, upload_only, and governed_only keys.

highlights.label: Label each key
notes: Pure helper covered by tests.
450 matched, 30 upload-only in the reference run.

highlights.label: Per-user folder
notes: Each user writes to their own folder.
The task fails if no key matches.

highlights.label: Connect with the SQL connector
notes: Uses OAuth M2M when a client id is set, the job identity otherwise.
Returned 4 regions and 5,000 customers in 1.56 s.

highlights.label: Python client example
notes: Copy-paste U2M and M2M sign-in.
Same governed tables and permissions as the workspace.

highlights.label: ODBC configuration for statistics tools
notes: U2M and M2M variants for SAS and SPSS.
Not run in the reference workspace.

highlights.label: The flow as one SQL statement
notes: Filter, join, rename, and derive, matching the Designer steps.
prep_flow_summary holds the totals to compare with the Designer output.

highlights.label: Formatted workbook and delimited file
notes: Styled header, number formats, autofilter, and a summary sheet.
Both files are read back and row counts checked.

highlights.label: Schedule and subscribe
notes: The bundle can't declare a subscription, so the task creates it.
Reruns reuse the existing schedule.

highlights.label: Two governed views
notes: Notebook charts and the dashboard read the same views.
Views are commented for discovery.

highlights.label: Notebook charts
notes: matplotlib images saved to a volume.
Chart totals written to chart_totals.

highlights.label: Dashboard and charts agree
notes: Runs the dashboard's own dataset queries on the warehouse.
Fails if any total differs.

highlights.label: Grant to groups only
notes: Raises on an email principal, so no person gets a direct grant.
Privilege names are validated.

highlights.label: Verify dev and prod differ
notes: Reads information_schema with inherited_from.
Separates direct grants from cascaded catalog privileges.

highlights.label: Fall back to a grantable group
notes: Workspace-local groups aren't Unity Catalog principals.
The job records the fallback to account users.

highlights.label: Masks that branch on identity
notes: session_user() is checked before is_member().
Identity expressions are parameters, so another identity can be simulated.

highlights.label: Create and attach the policies
notes: A region_access mapping table drives the dynamic filter.
Masks and filters attach with ALTER TABLE.

highlights.label: Test as each identity
notes: The simulation must reproduce the real result for the job identity.
Other identities are simulated; role switching is the real test.

highlights.label: Generate concurrent load
notes: 40 async statements against a temporary 2X-Small warehouse.
Shared warehouses are only read, never resized.

highlights.label: Measure queueing
notes: Waits for query history, then computes waits and peak concurrency.
Median wait at capacity was 61.1 s in the reference run.

highlights.label: Always delete the test warehouse
notes: delete_load_warehouse uses run_if ALL_DONE.
The warehouse is removed even if a task fails.

highlights.label: Spend by product, tag, user, and job
notes: Usage joined to list prices by effective window.
Scoped to this workspace.

highlights.label: 30-day forecast
notes: ai_forecast runs as a SQL task on the warehouse.
With only 3 days of history, it shows the method, not a plan.

highlights.label: Budget alert
notes: Alerts when 7-day spend passes budget_threshold_usd.
The threshold is a bundle variable per environment.

highlights.label: Create the feature table
notes: Uses the Feature Engineering client, with a primary-key Delta fallback.
Drops first, so reruns are idempotent.

highlights.label: Quality checks from the spec
notes: 16 checks built from the use-case spec.
Any failure fails the task.

highlights.label: Versioned training set
notes: Joins features and labels with VERSION AS OF.
Both table versions are recorded.

highlights.label: Wrap an existing pickled model
notes: Models-from-code loads the pickle as an artifact.
The wrapper class itself is never pickled.

highlights.label: Reproduce the recorded baseline
notes: Scores the same holdout through the registered model.
AUC 0.947689 reproduced within 0.001.

highlights.label: Record library and runtime versions
notes: Versions become run tags and a change log.
Shows exactly what differs between runtimes.

highlights.label: Tag data, code, and environment
notes: data_version, git_sha, code_hash, and the environment are tags.
Everything needed to rerun is on the run.

highlights.label: Move the data on
notes: New rows land after the recorded version.
Only a rerun that reads the recorded version can match.

highlights.label: Rerun and assert the result
notes: Original and rerun AUC both 0.947689.
A latest-data control shows the difference new data makes.

highlights.label: Population stability index
notes: Baseline quantile bins; a breach is PSI or mean shift over the threshold.
days_since_login reached PSI 3.86 in the shifted batches.

highlights.label: Retrain only on a breach
notes: breach_check gates the retrain_candidate task.
A person promotes the challenger.

highlights.label: Alert the owner
notes: SQL alert on the newest batch's max PSI.
Emails notification_email.

highlights.label: Secured requests and latency
notes: OAuth from the SDK; no PAT or secret.
p50 43.6 ms, p95 99.7 ms over 50 warm requests.

highlights.label: Optional features are filled
notes: The signature marks usage_score optional; an imputer fills it.
A missing required feature returns 400.

highlights.label: Create or update the endpoint
notes: Small size with scale-to-zero.
Waits for READY before scoring.

highlights.label: Terms, measures, and synonyms
notes: Revenue excludes cancelled orders with a FILTER clause.
Every term carries a synonyms list.

highlights.label: Ask the same questions twice
notes: Creates a space per stage and asks through the API.
Matched 0 of 5 before semantics and 5 of 5 after.

highlights.label: Compare answers to expected rows
notes: Ignores column names and order, not values.
A code like NA does not match North America.

highlights.label: Scripted user tasks
notes: Discovery, a question, a refinement, an ambiguous ask, and feedback.
Each task becomes a ux_session_log row.

highlights.label: Ask and give feedback
notes: Polls each message and retries on throttling.
Posts thumbs-up or thumbs-down feedback.

highlights.label: Find issues and training needs
notes: Rules flag failures, missing SQL, mismatches, and slow answers.
The ambiguous ask drew a clarifying question.

highlights.label: Share, read, revoke
notes: Create, grant, read with the delta-sharing client, revoke, confirm the read fails.
Records BLOCKED with the needed GRANT when CREATE SHARE is missing.

highlights.label: Shared in place, not copied
notes: Checks pre-signed file URLs sit under the source table path.
That is the evidence no replication happens.

highlights.label: Collect the audit trail
notes: Polls system.access.audit for the share and recipient.
Tolerates audit lag.

highlights.label: Create, evolve, and time travel
notes: USING ICEBERG, append, ADD COLUMN, VERSION AS OF.
Each step is recorded as a check.

highlights.label: PyIceberg REST catalog config
notes: URI, warehouse, token, and the vended-credentials header.
Without the header the data read is denied.

highlights.label: Read externally and compare
notes: PyIceberg read 1,500 rows, matching Spark.
A pushed-down filter returned 417 rows.

highlights.label: BI-style client on the warehouse
notes: Connects as the job identity or with OAuth M2M.
Results are cross-checked against Spark.

highlights.label: Query Postgres in place
notes: Creates the UC connection and tries a foreign catalog.
Falls back to remote_query when CREATE CATALOG is denied.

highlights.label: Remote query expression
notes: Builds the table expression for queries through the connection.
Aggregates run inside Postgres.

highlights.label: Ensure the group
notes: Creates the group only if missing.
A refused UC grant is recorded with its reason.

highlights.label: Idempotent action ledger
notes: MERGE keyed on run, category, action, and target.
A retried task never duplicates rows.

highlights.label: Apply a policy if it drifted
notes: Tries a budget policy, then a cluster policy.
Edits only when the definition changed.

recordedRuns.label: Support run with a failure by design

highlights.label: Classify and route failures
notes: The first matching pattern wins; tags pick the owner.
High severity also pages the escalation contact.

highlights.label: Count only the latest attempt
notes: Retries appear as separate task entries.
A task that passed on retry is not an incident.

highlights.label: Repair the failed run
notes: Repairs only failed tasks through the Jobs API.
The original run ended SUCCESS after repair.
